issues.location: equivalence between PA-squared entailment and validity of P implies A
issues.finding: The frozen source writes the satisfaction expression as '$\Sat{M}{!P \lif !A$}', closing math mode before the final argument brace. This leaves an unmatched brace outside math and can break TeX compilation. The intended well-formed expression is '$\Sat{M}{!P \lif !A}$'.
issues.proposed_resolution: Move the closing brace before the closing dollar. The Javanese target applies exactly this delimiter correction; QA v8 compares against a one-span bounded source view while preserving the frozen source bytes.

issues.finding: PA-squared entails A iff the implication P implies A is valid, which means every structure M satisfies it. The source's bare 'i.e., Sat_M(P implies A)' omits that universal structure scope and could be read as satisfaction in one unspecified structure.
issues.proposed_resolution: Say explicitly that Sat_M(P implies A) holds for every structure M. The Javanese target supplies this prose qualifier without adding a new mathematical expression.

translation_treatment: The target fixes the malformed Sat formula by one delimiter move and adds the universal-structure scope in prose. All other formulas, identifiers, references and commands remain source-aligned. OLPL-216 has a versioned QA comparison view and a correction-ledger entry; final reader build and visual readback remain necessary.
